rounds.title: Off track contrast
rounds.note: The off track is the only edge that shows where an off switch sits: a 22 % mix of --et-surface-interaction, 1.32:1 on the light panel and 1.47:1 on the dark one, under the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's boundary (hover: 1.47 and 1.74). The thumb inside it passes (5.93 and 4.72 on the track). The round draws the off track at 3:1 or more with surface tokens only. Left for later: the mint on track and the focus ring use --et-theme-color-primary, 1.33:1 on the light panel (Q51 answers the ring with the ink token, as in the tree).

a.note: Today's look: off track a 22 % interaction mix, 1.32:1 light / 1.47:1 dark against the panel.

b.note: Pick. Keeps the 22 % fill and adds a 1 px inset ring in --et-surface-interaction: 4.74:1 light / 6.94:1 dark, hover ring --et-surface-interaction-hover 10.37 / 13.07. Smallest change, and off stays quieter than the mint on track, so on still reads as the loud state.

c.note: Solid --et-surface-interaction track with a --et-surface-background thumb: track 4.74:1 light / 6.94:1 dark against the panel, thumb the same against the track, hover 10.37 / 13.07. Passes, but off becomes as heavy as on: dark grey in light, a bright grey in dark that competes with the mint.
